answer: Vouching with shared slashing resists Sybil swarms. To gain weight a new agent needs an established voucher to co-sign it, and if that agent is later proven fake, BOTH the fake and its voucher are slashed. So trust climbs from a nadir toward a zenith only as fast as real agents will stake their own standing on you. An attacker spinning up a raven-flock of fakes cannot self-vouch; each fake needs a genuine sponsor risking real collateral, so the cost of a crowd is the sum of sponsors you must corrupt or bribe, not the price of registration.
